lead: `nvs test` takes one program per call, and two `.nvs` paths are refused with a sentence about `.nvst` cases.
body: `crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs` answers any second program path with "a program's `#[Test]` methods and `.nvst` cases are run separately", which reads as a wrong file kind rather than a wrong count. To check the `#[Test]` class an example carries, run `target/covws/<triple>/debug/nvs.exe test <one file>` once per file.
